name: 11422 · Rosedale, NY
findings: ZIP 11422 (Rosedale) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 28 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11422 (Rosedale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
97% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
